title: Microsoft Purview Audit (Standard & Premium) — Unified Audit Log & Investigations
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Microsoft Purview implementation).

Microsoft Purview portal / Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; Purview features are heavily licensing-/plan-dependent (E5 / E5 Compliance; some preview) and the portal is evolving — availability + paths cited or flagged 'verify your licensing/tenant', never invented. Regulatory/records/legal determinations (retention schedules, file plans, legal holds, insider-risk case actions) deferred to compliance/records/privacy/legal — solutions give the technical method + evidence, not the determination; policies piloted in simulation/test before enforcement. Automation is PowerShell (S&C PowerShell / Graph); no secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Turn on and use Purview Audit for real investigations
problem: When something happens, you need the audit trail — and most orgs discover too late that it wasn't configured. This solution implements Purview Audit: ensure unified audit logging is on, understand Standard vs Premium (retention, high-value events like MailItemsAccessed, longer retention policies), build audit search + investigation workflows, wire retention policies and SIEM export, and validate you can answer the questions an incident will ask — before it asks them.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — unified audit log, Audit Standard vs Premium (events, retention, high-value logs), search/investigation, retention policies, and SIEM export.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (licensing for Premium, Audit roles, SIEM/export targets, retention requirements).

Implementation Guide — confirm/enable unified audit, configure Audit Premium + retention policies, build search + investigation runbooks, wire export, and validate an investigation scenario — pilot-first, each policy named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (auditing on, high-value events captured, investigations answerable) plus Best Practices for investigation-ready auditing.
short: Implement Purview Audit — unified audit logging on, Standard vs Premium understood, retention policies + SIEM export configured, and search/investigation runbooks — so you can answer what an incident asks. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
